nom: ANUA 8 Hyaluronic Acid Hydrating Gentle Foaming Cleanser

avis.texte: Have rosacea and this makes my skin feel soft and doesnt irritate it.

My skin reacts to truly everything — fragrance, essential oil, pretty much any type of oil, shea butter, all things coconut, etc. I'd been using La Roche Posay Toleriane for a long time, but occasionally it would sting my skin. Tried this cleanser per SkinSort's recommendation, and wow I'm glad I did. No stinging. My skin is less dry and more plump. Zero irritation. Great price point. A little goes a long way with the product. LOVE! Give it a try!

I absolutely LOVE this cleanser. I was getting tired of breakouts and wanted to try Korean skincare and came across this brand. It has done wonders for my skin. This cleanser is gentle and really gets my skin clean (I pair it with the Anua Heartleaf cleansing oil to double-cleanse my makeup off.) Just remember when reading reviews, everyone's skin is different and what works for some doesn't work for others It's important to pay attention to the ingredients and gain an understanding of what your skin will tolerate. I've had other products I've used where it worked great at first then I developed an allergic reaction after weeks of use. I love this cleanser and am glad to have found one that works well for my skin. Good luck!

avis.titre: gave me horrible acne.. worst cleanser ever
avis.texte: i've had this cleanser for about 2 months now, and at first when i starting using it, my skin started growing acne on my forehead and cheeks. i thought it was just hormonal acne or that i was just purging from using a new product. i kept using it and my skin would just get WORSE. a new pimple would grow on my face every day, and it would be so painful. i've never had such horrible acne until i used this product. i continuously used it for a month and the only results i got was red, large acne and pimples. i stopped using it and switched to a different cleanser, and my skin healed and cleared all its redness and bumps thanks to switching to something different. but i recently ran out of the cleanser and had to switch back to this for the moment. and not such a surprise, but my acne is back again and i currently have this huge pimple on my forehead that is literally so painful to touch. going to ulta to restock on the cleanser that healed my skin asap. (its the snail rescue purifying cleanser by peach slices. i love it so much!!)

This leaves my face clean and super soft. Nice creamy lather and it doesnt irritate my sensitive skin (recently started back on tret). cr Knocked it down one star because it has an odd (medicinal?) smell to me at first. That smell fades as I lather and doesn't stay on my skin at least.
This product is amazing for everybody, sensitive skin, acne, prone skin, even kid can use this.

I used this product for a good month and a half and was loving it. I had clear skin when all of a sudden on the 6th week of use my face broke out SOO BAD, red hives all over my face, irritation and swelling. I honestly thought it was an allergic reaction to something i had eaten, until the next morning i washed my face and the same thing happened. Ive discontinued using this cleanser and my face is much happier. Took about a week to fully heal.

This wrecked havoc on my skin. I normally don't break out but I immediately started having issues with random cystic acne popping up once I started using this. It was painful and took weeks to heal. I've discontinued using this and have thrown it out.

I have been in the hunt for a good hydrating cleanser….I have semi sensitive skin and after I use this cleanser my face feels supple and soft. I bought the entire system and it all works great together.

avis.titre: This gave me dermatitis around my eyes
avis.texte: I've never had a reaction to a face wash but this one gave me red peeling skin. Beware if you have sensitive skin.

Omg!!! I have the most sensitive and acne prone skin. Its also dry and I suffer from perioral dermatitis. Vanicream is my go to cleanser, but Ive been wanting something more hydrating. This has been the BEST cleanser I have ever used. I've been using it for a month now and theres no irritation or acne. This truly cleans my face AND leaves it so soft. Highly reccomend!

I've been on the hunt for cleansers that are safe for my increasingly sensitive skin, and this has been great, so far. It hasn't bothered my perifacial dermatitis, at all. It also does the job of actually getting my skin clean. I also love how hydrating it is while being oil free. My only caveat is that it does sting a bit if some suds get in my eyes; which has not been an issue with the last couple cleansers that I've used.
